The [[Serroco system/Legends|Serroco system]] in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region's]] [[Ploo sector/Legends|Ploo sector]] had at least one '''[[Star/Legends|star]]'''. The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Serroco]], [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Stereb]] [[Species/Legends|species]], revolved around this [[Color/Legends|yellow]] star.
